description_en: Modifies the configuration of a machine group
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-machine-group --project ali-test-project --group-name test-group --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMachineGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the machine group
parameters.name: group_name

fields.help_en: The identifier of the external management system on which the machine group depends. This parameter is empty by default
fields.help_zh: 机器组所依赖的外部管理系统标识。默认为空
fields.name: external_name

fields.help_en: The topic of the machine group. This parameter is empty by default
fields.help_zh: 机器组的日志主题。默认为空
fields.name: group_topic

parameters.help_en: The attribute of the machine group. This parameter is empty by default
parameters.help_zh: 机器组的属性，默认为空
parameters.name: group_attribute

parameters.help_en: The type of the machine group. Set the value to an empty string
parameters.help_zh: 机器组类型，固定为空字符串
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
The identifier type of the machine group. Valid values:

ip: The machine group uses IP addresses as identifiers.

userdefined: The machine group uses custom identifiers
parameters.help_zh:
机器组标识类型。

ip：IP地址机器组。
userdefined：用户自定义标识机器组
parameters.name: machine_identify_type

parameters.help_en:
The identifiers of the machines in the machine group.

If you set machineIdentifyType to ip, enter the IP addresses of the machines.

If you set machineIdentifyType to userdefined, enter a custom identifier
parameters.help_zh:
机器组的标识信息。

如果machineIdentifyType配置为ip，则此处填写服务器的IP地址。
如果machineIdentifyType配置为userdefined，则此处填写自定义的标识
parameters.name: machine_list
